title: Our Children
overview: "Our war is not against each other. It is against the hatred taking the lives of our children." In memory of Eyal Ifrah zt"l, Gil-Ad Sha'ar zt"l, Naftali Fraenkel zt"l, Mohammed Abu Khdeir (pbuh), Sa'ad Dawabsha (pbuh), Riham Dawabsha (pbuh), Ali Sa'ad Dawabsha (pbuh). "Roads" written, performed and recorded by Portishead.
